title: koeleria sibirensis
intro: Koeleria sibirensis, commonly known as Siberian bluegrass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria sibirensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit potential antitumor activity. The bioactive constituents present in Koeleria sibirensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
